headline: Argentina Restricts Chinese Network Equipment and Cell Phone Imports
summary: Argentina's National Cybersecurity Center began restricting Chinese cell phone and critical network equipment imports by requiring certification from a U.S. private association.
why: The National Cybersecurity Center regulates technology infrastructure and telecommunications standards in Argentina.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Trade and cybersecurity restrictions alter the supply chain options for telecommunications equipment imports.
